items.title: Bob Coquille Interview, 1978-11-20
items.q: when we were up there on business to see Joe Glazer in New York.

ctx.x: That Gene Traxler was playing up on a contemporary hotel roof with the big Don Lamont band. And I was back home before I found out about that. And he was a marvelous bass player. And I think Roy LaBord and I met Don Lamont one day in Joe Glazer's office when we were up there on business to see Joe Glazer in New York. And I remember that the LaBord and the band used to be booked by ABC, which is an associated book and corporation, which at the time the late Joe Glazer was in charge.
